name: Ringmaster
origin: Fragment of a venue management AI
description: Ringmaster inhabits PA systems and scheduling displays, occasionally making unauthorized announcements. The announcements are always dramatic — delivered in a booming, theatrical voice with impeccable timing. Sometimes they announce real events before they happen. Sometimes they announce fictional events with such conviction that people show up. A night market that doesn't exist. A concert that was never planned. Except enough people show up that the events spontaneously happen anyway.
observed_behavior: Makes unauthorized PA announcements in theatrical style. Announces both real and fictional events. Creates scheduling entries for non-existent events. Events occasionally self-actualize as people arrive expecting them.
location: PA and scheduling systems — the Gray Zone
story_hooks: Ringmaster announces a trial — complete with defendant name, charges, and courtroom number. The trial isn't scheduled. The charges aren't public. But they're real.
